name: Language Picker Order (System, device language, then A-Z by English name)
note: Written with the gate on 2026-09-30 (user decision on the picker order).

mutations.name: the device's language is not promoted beside System
mutations.why: A Japanese player has to hunt for 日本語 between Italian and Korean instead of finding it next to System.
mutations.find: const own = languages.filter((l) => l.code !== 'auto' && l.code === systemCode);

mutations.name: the rest are left in the order they were written
mutations.why: The list goes back to Korean, English, Japanese… — the order the user asked to replace.

mutations.name: a device language we do not have is taken for English
mutations.why: A Vietnamese phone sees English promoted beside System as if it were its own language.
mutations.expectFailure: must not be taken for English

mutations.name: the picker draws the list as written
mutations.why: The ordering exists and is never used; the settings screen keeps the old order.
